en.question: Which statement best describes when to choose a self-hosted agent deployment over a managed one?

options.text: Self-hosting is reliably cheaper once inference volume passes a threshold.
options.note: Total cost frequently rises once engineering time is counted.

options.text: It suits residency, isolation, or deep internal integration requirements.
Managed deployments cannot register custom, organisation-specific tools.
options.note: Custom tools work in either deployment model.

options.text: Self-hosting removes the need to manage and rotate an API credential.
options.note: Model inference still requires authenticated API access.

en.explanation: The trade is control against operational burden. Self-hosting the harness satisfies residency, isolation, and integration constraints, but you then own scaling, upgrades, monitoring, and incidents.
